title: Director of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.


THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships


WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results
  • Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate
  • Remote-first with regional travel as required
  • Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one
  • A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM


MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Senior AI Agent Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.


The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.


What you'll do

• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

• Compare models against each other (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.


Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.


Preferred Qualifications:

• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, LangGraph, or the OpenAI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.


This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.


Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.


Preferred Qualifications:

• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, LangGraph, or the OpenAI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.


This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Junior Spanish Recruiter
description:
Location: São Paulo, SP or Bragança Paulista, SP

Work Model: Hybrid or Remote


About the Role

We are looking for a Junior Recruiter to join our team and support our staffing and outsourcing operations .


This role is ideal for someone who is building a career in recruitment and enjoys connecting with people, identifying talent, and building candidate relationships . You will support recruitment processes for international clients and candidates, with a strong focus on the Spanish-speaking market .


What You'll Do

  • Source and build pipelines of qualified candidates.
  • Conduct initial candidate screenings and interviews.
  • Review resumes and assess candidates against job requirements.
  • Conduct outreach through calls, messages, and other sourcing channels.
  • Maintain accurate candidate information in our internal systems.
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to support hiring needs.
  • Work toward weekly recruitment activity and productivity goals.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent English and Spanish .
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to build relationships and confidently speak with candidates.
  • Good organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with activity goals and recruitment targets.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • High motivation and interest in developing a career in recruitment.


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment, sourcing, HR, customer service, or sales .
  • Experience recruiting for the Spanish-speaking market .
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, or ATS platforms .
  • Experience in staffing, outsourcing, or international recruitment.


If you're energetic, people-oriented, and ready to grow your career in recruitment, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Online Business English Teacher
description:
About the job

Company Description C-Leader English Academy helps professionals and executives develop the business English they need to perform in real-world corporate situations. The academy offers highly personalized programs tailored to each learner’s professional context, goals, and communication challenges, avoiding generic classes and focusing on efficiency. Its method combines realistic business scenarios, strategic communication practice, and direct application to daily work routines. This approach builds confidence, clarity, and measurable impact in the workplace. C-Leader is ideal for those seeking structured, purposeful, and fast-paced language development that supports leadership and global positioning.

Role Description

The Online Business English Teacher will deliver high-quality business-focused English lessons to professionals and executives, using C-Leader’s personalized methodology. Day-to-day tasks include preparing tailored lesson plans based on learners’ industries and roles, conducting live online classes, and focusing on communication skills for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership contexts. The teacher will assess learner progress, provide detailed feedback, and adjust content to address evolving communication needs and business scenarios. Responsibilities also include maintaining accurate records of sessions, collaborating with the academic team to refine materials, and ensuring a consistent, professional learning experience. This is an online work position, and is open only to non-Brazilian candidates.


Requirements/Qualifications: (Please ONLY apply if you MEET ALL the following requisites)

-ACTIVE CNPJ is essential and mandatory

-FLUENT ENGLISH at teaching level with excellent grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation suitable for business environments.

-International TEACHING CERTIFICATION or graduation in Education, Languages, Linguistics, Business, or a related field; international teaching certificates (e.g., CELTA, TESOL).

-Proven solid EXPERIENCE teaching English to professionals or executives, with a focus on business or corporate communication.

-Proven experience with ONLINE TEACHING

-Ability to design and deliver personalized lesson plans based on learners’ job roles, industries, and real business situations.

-Skills in facilitating communication practice for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership interactions.

-Comfort with online teaching tools, learning platforms, and digital resources to support interactive and engaging classes.

-Strong interpersonal skills, cultural awareness, and the ability to work with diverse, high-level professionals in a respectful, inclusive manner.

-Know how to use Google Meet and Notion for teaching

-Having a good computer setup and a stable internet connection

title: HR Business Partner - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role: We are looking for a HR Business Partner to join our Human Resources team. We are looking for proactive, dynamic people and team players, with great organizational capacity, accustomed to handle multiple tasks and with marked attention to details. It is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!


Key responsibilities:


- Hold regular meetings with the respective business units and management, providing guidance on HR issues.

- Analyze trends and metrics related to the level of rotation in order to develop solutions, programs and policies to increase retention.

- Stay updated on the legal requirements related to the daily management of employees, giving priority to the reduction of legal risks and guaranteeing regulatory compliance.

- Provide guidance and assistance in interpreting HR policies.

- Solve complex problems of various kinds related to employees.

- Assist international employees with expatriation assignments and HR-related matters.


Requirements:


- Previous experience in similar positions within the area.

- Knowledge of the labor regulations of Argentina and Latin America.

- Communication skills.

- Experience in the IT industry or regional responsibility (desirable).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Electrical BIM/VDC Coordinator
description:
At Consultores de Empresas , we are looking for an Electrical BIM/VDC Coordinator !

We are seeking a professional with experience in BIM/VDC, electrical modeling, and construction project coordination to join a team working on highly complex commercial projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Interpret and analyze construction documentation for electrical systems.
  • Design and model conduit systems according to design and constructability criteria.
  • Develop and manage LOD 400 electrical models in Revit .
  • Perform clash detection and resolution using Navisworks and Revizto .
  • Coordinate the electrical model with different disciplines and project teams.
  • Produce sleeve drawings, embedded points, and coordinate shop drawings.
  • Ensure model accuracy and compliance with applicable codes.
  • Resolve modeling issues and provide technical solutions.
  • Support field operations through remote coordination.
  • Occasionally collaborate on mechanical/MEP and process piping modeling tasks.


Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in BIM/VDC and construction modeling .
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in electrical project coordination .
  • Experience in electrical trades/installations.
  • Revit mandatory , with strong experience in detailed electrical modeling.
  • Experience working with LOD 350–400 electrical models .
  • Experience interpreting construction documentation.
  • Knowledge of Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD and BIM 360 is a plus.
  • Understanding of MEP systems and their integration into modeling workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving and coordination skills.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in remote environments.


Project Experience

Experience in the following projects is a plus:

  • ️ Data Centers / Critical Infrastructure
  • Healthcare Facilities
  • Educational Institutions
  • Semiconductor Manufacturing Plants
  • Commercial and Retail Projects


We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Excellent communication and strong remote work capabilities.
  • A proactive and autonomous approach.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and a strong focus on quality.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Interest in adopting new tools and industry practices.


Location: Latin America | Remote

If you have experience in BIM/VDC and electrical modeling in Revit , we want to hear from you!

title: Administrador(a) de Dados Senior
description:
Buscamos um(a) Administrador(a) de Dados Sênior com experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados, conhecimento em negócios bancários e atuação com framework BIAN, arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA), Apache Kafka e governança de eventos .

O profissional atuará na modelagem, administração e governança de dados e eventos, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, analistas de negócio e equipes de desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar e modelar dados nos níveis conceitual, lógico e físico , alinhados às necessidades de negócio e aos requisitos regulatórios;
  • Aplicar os princípios do framework BIAN na modelagem de dados, serviços bancários e integrações sistêmicas;
  • Atuar na governança de dados transacionais e orientados a eventos , definindo padrões, políticas e melhores práticas;
  • Definir, versionar e governar eventos em Apache Kafka , incluindo tópicos, contratos de dados e fluxos de publicação e consumo;
  • Projetar, estruturar e manter schemas AVRO , garantindo compatibilidade, versionamento e aderência aos padrões corporativos;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de qualidade de dados, catálogo de dados, linhagem e metadados corporativos ;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos de solução, arquitetos corporativos, analistas de negócio e times de desenvolvimento ;
  • Atuar junto às esteiras CI/CD , apoiando a automação de deploys e validações de modelos, eventos e schemas;
  • Documentar e manter atualizados os ativos de dados, eventos e artefatos de governança .

Requisitos

Experiência e conhecimentos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados ;
  • Conhecimento de negócios bancários , principalmente em assuntos como Cheque Especial, Conta e Pagamentos ;
  • Conhecimento prático e aplicável do framework BIAN ;
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) e Apache Kafka ;
  • Conhecimento em governança de eventos , incluindo definição de contratos, versionamento e políticas de compatibilidade;
  • Experiência na modelagem e gestão de schemas AVRO (Schema Registry) ;
  • Conhecimento em esteiras CI/CD ;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem de dados como Erwin, PowerDesigner ou similares ;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL ;
  • Entendimento e aplicação de normas de compliance e privacidade de dados , incluindo LGPD e GDPR .

Formação

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas .

description:
Responsibilities:

- Explore all relevant telecommunications resources (VOIP, SIP trunk, SMS channel) in target countries, industries, and target markets

- Maintain good relationships with telecom resource suppliers/ telecom operators

- Attend telecom trade meetings periodically

- Work closely with the team to integrate telecom resources into our product/platform


Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

- +5 Years of practical experience in exploring/purchasing telecom resources. (sip trunk, sms channel)

- Great passion for technology products and the telecom industry

- Good at critical reasoning and multi-tasking implementation

- Good communicative skills and business acumen

- Passionate and result-oriented

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office

- Proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications:

- Work experience in telecom operators.

- Five years or more of practical experience in telecom resource sales and purchasing

- Good understanding of industry research

- Successful track record in maintaining supplier relationships and people management

- Good interpersonal and teamwork skills.


About AI Rudder

AI Rudder is a conversational AI company on a mission to transform how businesses communicate with their customers — across voice and digital channels that feel genuinely human.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Singapore, we're building technologies that bridge languages, enhance understanding, and enable meaningful human–machine communication at scale.

Today, we serve 500+ enterprise clients globally processing 50 million calls daily and having delivered more than 8 billion calls to date.

Most recently, we have raised $50M in a Series B fundraising from leading global investors including Tiger Global, Peak XV Partners, and Cathay Innovation.


How We Work

AI-first: AI isn't a tool we reach for. It's the default we start from. Every team, every workflow: AI-first.

Global Collaboration: We operate globally and work as one team. Distance is a logistics problem, not a cultural one. We build the habits that make distributed teams actually work.

Communication Principle: Simple, Trust, Transparent. We remove unnecessary complexity so people can focus on what matters most.


What We Offer

Learning & Development: Continuous learning through real projects, knowledge sharing session, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.

Performance Recognition: Regular performance reviews, feedback, and opportunities for career progression.

Global Exposure: Collaborate with international teams, global rotations, and work with global enterprise customers.

Meaningful Impact: Build AI solutions that create real value for businesses around the world.

Ownership & Autonomy: Freedom to take initiative and drive outcomes.

Team Engagement: Team Building, Local & Global Gatherings & Local Events Celebration.


AI Rudder is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.

title: Finance Analyst - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are seeking a Finance Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Finance Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Perform research and gather documentation to compile comprehensive reports delivering operational reports, and transactional tasks.

- Work with banking/financial entities, international agencies, or government officials.

- Assist in vendor and client registration, purchasing, and accounts payable processes.

- Data processing: responsible for updating records in the company system.

- Assist in the department's programs, projects, and processes.

- Assist in the preparation of monthly financial reports.

- Assist in tracking due dates and compliance with US tax returns and other legal requirements.


Requirements:


- 3+ years of experience working in finance areas.

- Expertise with web-based tools.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Interpersonal and presentation skills.

- Organized and detail-oriented.

- Proven organizational skills.

- Advanced English, both spoken and written (a must).


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Native or Bilingual German & Japanese Teachers | Freelance
description:
LingoGalaxy is looking for native or bilingual German- or Japanese-speaking teachers to deliver personalized online lessons to children and teenagers.


You do not need to be registered as a freelancer to work with LingoGalaxy.

All lessons are fully online, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere. Previous experience teaching children is preferred but not required .


What We Offer
  • Fully remote teaching — work from anywhere.
  • Flexible scheduling — minimum availability of 12 hours per week during our peak teaching hours:
  • 16:00–20:00 CET for European students
  • 16:00–20:00 EST for US students
  • Dedicated HR support — our HR team is available throughout your collaboration to assist with student-related, scheduling, technical, or other work-related issues.


Creative Freedom in Your Teaching

We encourage teachers to use their own teaching resources and create engaging, age-appropriate lesson presentations tailored to each student's needs.

This is an opportunity to use your own teaching style, creativity, and ideas to develop lessons that work well for your students and that you genuinely enjoy teaching. We also provide guidance and resources when needed.


Compensation
  • €8 per 30-minute lesson
  • €14 per 60-minute lesson


Requirements
  • Native or bilingual German or Japanese proficiency.
  • Availability for at least 12 hours per week during the specified peak hours .
  • Ability and willingness to create engaging, age-appropriate lesson materials.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable setup for online teaching.


If you are looking for a flexible online German or Japanese teaching opportunity where you can use your own teaching style and creativity, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Business Intelligence Partner - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.


Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.


When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.


Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor at BairesDev


As a Senior Auditor , you'll play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and reliability of recruitment audits. You'll handle complex and high-impact cases, review and guide junior auditors, and help align evaluation criteria across the team. This role offers the chance to make a real impact by improving the quality of hiring processes, working on meaningful and complex cases, shaping audit standards, and helping both processes and people grow through clear feedback and continuous improvement.


What You'll Do:


- Execute complex, sensitive, and high-impact audits.

- Supervise and review Junior Auditors' evaluations.

- Lead calibration calls and standardize criteria across the audit team.


What we are looking for:


- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance roles.

- Proven experience auditing complex and high-impact roles, including senior profiles, closers, and specialized positions.

- Hands-on experience supervising and calibrating Junior Auditors to ensure consistency and accuracy across evaluations.

- Advanced proficiency in English.


Nice to have:


- Experience in Talent Acquisition.

- Experience working with high-volume recruitment processes.

- Experience in data analysis and SQL.


How we do make your work (and your life) easier:


- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.


Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: Head of Risk
description:
Head of Credit Risk

We’re partnering with a fast-growing, profitable fintech transforming how small businesses in Brazil access credit and working capital. The company has built a highly automated, data-driven credit platform and is entering its next phase of significant scale and product expansion.


The role:

  • Own credit strategy, policy, portfolio performance, and credit P&L
  • Identify opportunities to sustainably scale the existing credit business
  • Partner closely with Product to design and launch new credit products
  • Serve as a strategic counterpart to Data Science/modeling leadership
  • Set direction in a highly entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment
  • Build and develop a high-performing risk organization as the business scales


Ideal background:

  • Launched a new credit product and successfully scaled it
  • Managed a large-scale credit portfolio with meaningful P&L and policy ownership
  • Experience managing multiple credit products simultaneously
  • Strong technical fluency across underwriting, modeling, and data science
  • First-principles thinker who can challenge conventional credit assumptions
  • Proven ability to operate in high-growth environments with strategic ambiguity
  • Strong track record of attracting and developing top talent
  • Brazil / Portuguese fluency strongly preferred

title: Digital Designer (Marketing)
description:
Overview

Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency with a growing (20+) distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end strategy, design and production services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

We're looking for a Digital Designer (Marketing) to join our team and work primarily with our retainer clients. Unlike project-based work, you'll develop deep, ongoing relationships with a portfolio of clients, becoming an extension of their marketing teams and developing an intimate understanding of their brands, audiences, and business goals.

You'll report to both the Design Team Lead and Head of Creative and Strategy, working across a wide range of marketing assets. This role requires a designer who thrives on variety, works quickly without sacrificing quality, and has a deep understanding of marketing asset creation across digital channels.

Key Responsibilities
Marketing Asset Creation
  • Designing social media content across platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook), including static posts, carousels, and stories
  • Creating webinar and event graphics, including promotional banners, registration pages, presentation templates, and recap assets
  • Developing one-pagers, sell sheets, and product/feature overviews
  • Designing email headers, newsletter templates, and digital campaign assets
  • Creating infographics, data visualizations, and report layouts
  • Designing blog graphics, featured images, and content marketing visuals
  • Producing landing page designs and website banners
  • Creating presentation decks for sales, investors, and internal use
  • Designing trade show and event collateral (booth graphics, handouts, signage)
  • Adapting and resizing assets for multiple formats and platforms
Brand Stewardship
  • Maintaining brand consistency across all touchpoints for assigned clients
  • Building and maintaining template libraries and asset repositories
  • Contributing to design system development and documentation
  • Evolving client brands within established guidelines while keeping them fresh


Collaboration & Process
  • Working under the supervision of the Design Team Lead while maintaining direct communication with leadership
  • Collaborating closely with Account Managers to understand client priorities and deadlines
  • Managing multiple client requests simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail
  • Participating in client calls and incorporating feedback quickly
  • Working efficiently within retainer hour allocations
Key KPIs
  • Operational Efficiency: Deviation from estimates <10%
  • Client Satisfaction (CSAT): Average score 4.7+
  • Internal Quality Score: Average score 4.7+
  • Client Creative Feedback: Average score 4.7+
  • Turnaround Time: Meeting SLAs for retainer deliverables
Requirements
  • 3-5+ years of experience in marketing design, preferably at an agency or in-house marketing team
  • Deep experience with marketing asset types: social media graphics, webinar materials, one-pagers, email templates, presentations, infographics
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and their design requirements/best practices
  • Expert proficiency in Figma (primary tool)
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
  • Proficiency with AI tools
  • Experience with motion/animation tools a plus (After Effects, Lottie)
  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple client accounts
  • Comfortable with remote collaboration via Slack, video calls, and project management tools
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating range across marketing asset types
Nice to Have
  • Experience working with B2B technology brands
  • Basic motion design / animation skills
  • Experience with HubSpot, Marketo, or other marketing automation platforms
  • Understanding of conversion-focused design principles
  • Experience building and maintaining design systems


The Perks
  • Diverse team (team members are based in US, UK, Europe, Canada, LATAM)
  • Working with interesting clients in the technology space
  • Fully remote
  • A highly cooperative team that encourages professional growth and self-development
  • Salary is commensurate with experience and market-rate at the candidate's location


﻿To be considered, apply with your cover letter, CV, and portfolio.

Site oficial:

title: SR Arquiteto de Soluções SAP FI-CO
description:
Aqui na Zallpy, tecnologia nasce de pessoas curiosas, colaborativas e com vontade de fazer bem feito. Se você gosta de ambientes onde existe espaço para perguntar, testar, aprender e evoluir junto, se liga nessa oportunidade!

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Zallpy, valorizamos um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam ser quem são, com respeito, segurança e pertencimento. Incentivamos especialmente a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e garantimos um ambiente acessível, com adaptações e suporte ao longo da jornada.

Também encorajamos pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIA+ e profissionais de diferentes origens a se candidatarem.

Aqui, você pode ser quem é, em cada fase da sua jornada. Vem com a gente. 🚀

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar em um time que pensa grande, trabalha com atenção aos detalhes, parceria no dia a dia e responsabilidade compartilhada. Acreditamos em autonomia, troca entre diferentes experiências e soluções construídas em conjunto.

Por aqui, crescer significa compartilhar conhecimento, respeitar diferentes formas de pensar e construir relações de confiança enquanto entregamos tecnologia de qualidade.

Se você se identifica com esse jeito de trabalhar, vem somar com a gente.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar a definição da arquitetura funcional e técnica de soluções SAP end-to-end, envolvendo múltiplos módulos e integrações.
  • Atuar na concepção de soluções para projetos de implementação, evolução e migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-venda, contribuindo na elaboração de propostas técnicas, definição de soluções e estimativas de esforço.
  • Definir estratégias de integração entre ambientes SAP, sistemas legados e demais aplicações corporativas.
  • Avaliar impactos de mudanças, garantindo aderência à arquitetura corporativa e às melhores práticas do ecossistema SAP.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de desenvolvimento, consultoria funcional e gestão de projetos.
  • Conduzir a estratégia de Clean Core em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, promovendo soluções sustentáveis e escaláveis.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, como Financeiro, Operações, Manufatura, Supply Chain e Comercial, traduzindo necessidades em soluções de arquitetura.


O que estamos buscando:

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções SAP.
  • Vivência como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, Arquiteto Corporativo, Especialista SAP ou Líder de Arquitetura.
  • Participação em projetos de implementação, transformação ou migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência em processos de pré-venda e desenho de soluções do ecossistema SAP.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos processos de negócio, especialmente Financeiro, Compras, Vendas e Produção.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de integração entre soluções SAP e sistemas corporativos.
  • Conhecimento das metodologias de implementação SAP (Activate ou similares).
  • Vivência em ambientes complexos, multiempresas e de grande porte.
  • Capacidade de atuar junto a executivos, stakeholders de negócio e equipes multidisciplinares.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Possuir inglês avançado.
  • Ter experiência com SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Fiori, SAP BTP e SAP Integration Suite.
  • Possuir visão funcional integrada dos módulos FI, MM e SD.
  • Ter experiência com estratégias de Clean Core e arquitetura orientada a boas práticas SAP.
  • Ser capaz de orquestrar especialistas técnicos e funcionais na construção de soluções de arquitetura.
  • Possuir certificações atualizadas em SAP relacionadas à arquitetura, SAP S/4HANA ou SAP BTP.


Onde você vai trabalhar:

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação remota


Modalidades de contratação

  • CLT.
  • Cooperado.


Benefícios de ser um Zallper:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição

Cartão multibenefícios Caju, em formato crédito, oferecendo flexibilidade para o dia a dia. (Exclusivo CLT) *

Plano de Saúde Unimed

Sem carência ou coparticipação para o titular. Possibilidade de inclusão de dependentes (filhos, cônjuge ou enteados), com coparticipação. (Exclusivo CLT) *

🦷 Plano Odontológico Uniodonto

Inclusão de dependentes com valores acessíveis. (Exclusivo CLT) *

Wellhub

Acesso a academias, atividades físicas e bem-estar.

🧘 Zenklub

Para CLTs: Duas consultas gratuitas por mês e valores diferenciados para sessões adicionais.

Para Cooperados/PJ: valores acessíveis para sessões.

🛡 Seguro de Vida

Mais segurança para você e sua família. (Exclusivo CLT)*

Auxílio Creche

Apoio financeiro para zallpers com filhos(as) de 4 meses a 6 anos, conforme critérios da política interna. (Exclusivo CLT) *

Baby Zallpy

Um mimo especial para celebrar a chegada de novos babies zallpers.

Acompanhamento de Business Partners

Suporte próximo e humanizado da área de Pessoas & Cultura ao longo da sua jornada na Zallpy.

Comunidades internas voluntárias

Diversidade, Esporte & Movimento e Tecnologia.

Parcerias educacionais

Descontos em graduação, pós-graduação, cursos livres e ensino de idiomas.

✈️ Experiências e desenvolvimento

Participação em eventos, workshops, viagens e ações de team building.

Programa de Indicação

Indique talentos para a Zallpy e receba bônus de R$ 2.500 a R$ 5.000.


* Modalidade Cooperado / PJ: Para essas modalidades, os benefícios listados acima são aplicáveis, com exceção daqueles sinalizados com asterisco (*), que são exclusivos da modalidade CLT. Além disso, contamos com plataformas específicas para a gestão de cooperados e PJs, garantindo organização, transparência e uma experiência estruturada ao longo de toda a jornada. 😉

Aqui na Zallpy, tecnologia nasce de pessoas curiosas, colaborativas e com vontade de fazer bem feito. Se você gosta de ambientes onde existe espaço para perguntar, testar, aprender e evoluir junto, se liga nessa oportunidade!

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Zallpy, valorizamos um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam ser quem são, com respeito, segurança e pertencimento. Incentivamos especialmente a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e garantimos um ambiente acessível, com adaptações e suporte ao longo da jornada.

Também encorajamos pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIA+ e profissionais de diferentes origens a se candidatarem.

Aqui, você pode ser quem é, em cada fase da sua jornada. Vem com a gente. 🚀

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar em um time que pensa grande, trabalha com atenção aos detalhes, parceria no dia a dia e responsabilidade compartilhada. Acreditamos em autonomia, troca entre diferentes experiências e soluções construídas em conjunto.

Por aqui, crescer significa compartilhar conhecimento, respeitar diferentes formas de pensar e construir relações de confiança enquanto entregamos tecnologia de qualidade.

Se você se identifica com esse jeito de trabalhar, vem somar com a gente.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar a definição da arquitetura funcional e técnica de soluções SAP end-to-end, envolvendo múltiplos módulos e integrações.
  • Atuar na concepção de soluções para projetos de implementação, evolução e migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-venda, contribuindo na elaboração de propostas técnicas, definição de soluções e estimativas de esforço.
  • Definir estratégias de integração entre ambientes SAP, sistemas legados e demais aplicações corporativas.
  • Avaliar impactos de mudanças, garantindo aderência à arquitetura corporativa e às melhores práticas do ecossistema SAP.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de desenvolvimento, consultoria funcional e gestão de projetos.
  • Conduzir a estratégia de Clean Core em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, promovendo soluções sustentáveis e escaláveis.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, como Financeiro, Operações, Manufatura, Supply Chain e Comercial, traduzindo necessidades em soluções de arquitetura.


O que estamos buscando:

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções SAP.
  • Vivência como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, Arquiteto Corporativo, Especialista SAP ou Líder de Arquitetura.
  • Participação em projetos de implementação, transformação ou migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência em processos de pré-venda e desenho de soluções do ecossistema SAP.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos processos de negócio, especialmente Financeiro, Compras, Vendas e Produção.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de integração entre soluções SAP e sistemas corporativos.
  • Conhecimento das metodologias de implementação SAP (Activate ou similares).
  • Vivência em ambientes complexos, multiempresas e de grande porte.
  • Capacidade de atuar junto a executivos, stakeholders de negócio e equipes multidisciplinares.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Possuir inglês avançado.
  • Ter experiência com SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Fiori, SAP BTP e SAP Integration Suite.
  • Possuir visão funcional integrada dos módulos FI, MM e SD.
  • Ter experiência com estratégias de Clean Core e arquitetura orientada a boas práticas SAP.
  • Ser capaz de orquestrar especialistas técnicos e funcionais na construção de soluções de arquitetura.
  • Possuir certificações atualizadas em SAP relacionadas à arquitetura, SAP S/4HANA ou SAP BTP.


Onde você vai trabalhar:

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação remota


Modalidades de contratação

  • CLT.
  • Cooperado.


Benefícios de ser um Zallper:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição

Cartão multibenefícios Caju, em formato crédito, oferecendo flexibilidade para o dia a dia. (Exclusivo CLT) *

Plano de Saúde Unimed

Sem carência ou coparticipação para o titular. Possibilidade de inclusão de dependentes (filhos, cônjuge ou enteados), com coparticipação. (Exclusivo CLT) *

🦷 Plano Odontológico Uniodonto

Inclusão de dependentes com valores acessíveis. (Exclusivo CLT) *

Wellhub

Acesso a academias, atividades físicas e bem-estar.

🧘 Zenklub

Para CLTs: Duas consultas gratuitas por mês e valores diferenciados para sessões adicionais.

Para Cooperados/PJ: valores acessíveis para sessões.

🛡 Seguro de Vida

Mais segurança para você e sua família. (Exclusivo CLT)*

Auxílio Creche

Apoio financeiro para zallpers com filhos(as) de 4 meses a 6 anos, conforme critérios da política interna. (Exclusivo CLT) *

Baby Zallpy

Um mimo especial para celebrar a chegada de novos babies zallpers.

Acompanhamento de Business Partners

Suporte próximo e humanizado da área de Pessoas & Cultura ao longo da sua jornada na Zallpy.

Comunidades internas voluntárias

Diversidade, Esporte & Movimento e Tecnologia.

Parcerias educacionais

Descontos em graduação, pós-graduação, cursos livres e ensino de idiomas.

✈️ Experiências e desenvolvimento

Participação em eventos, workshops, viagens e ações de team building.

Programa de Indicação

Indique talentos para a Zallpy e receba bônus de R$ 2.500 a R$ 5.000.


* Modalidade Cooperado / PJ: Para essas modalidades, os benefícios listados acima são aplicáveis, com exceção daqueles sinalizados com asterisco (*), que são exclusivos da modalidade CLT. Além disso, contamos com plataformas específicas para a gestão de cooperados e PJs, garantindo organização, transparência e uma experiência estruturada ao longo de toda a jornada. 😉

title: ESPECIALISTA EM PCP / MANUFATURA – TOTVS PROTHEUS
description:
VAGA: ESPECIALISTA EM PCP / MANUFATURA – TOTVS PROTHEUS


Estamos buscando um profissional Pleno ou Sênior, com sólida experiência em TOTVS Protheus , para atuar com PCP, manufatura, implantação, parametrização, sustentação e atendimento consultivo a clientes .


Buscamos um profissional que tenha forte domínio dos processos de planejamento e controle da produção dentro do Protheus , sendo capaz de analisar cenários, identificar inconsistências, realizar parametrizações e propor soluções funcionais para os desafios dos clientes.


Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido

Presencial: 2 dias por semana

Atuação: Suporte, implantação, sustentação e consultoria em clientes


FOCO DA VAGA


O principal foco desta posição será atuar nos módulos de Manufatura do TOTVS Protheus , especialmente:


SIGAPCP – PCP / Planejamento e Controle da Produção

SIGAEST – Estoque / Custos

SIGADPR – Desenvolvimento de Produtos

SIGAQIE – Inspeção de Entrada / Qualidade


Buscamos um profissional com capacidade de compreender todo o fluxo produtivo , desde a estruturação do produto e seus componentes, passando pelo planejamento e execução da produção, movimentação dos estoques e controles relacionados à qualidade.

O profissional deverá atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o processo do cliente, identificando a causa dos problemas e propondo a melhor solução dentro do ecossistema TOTVS Protheus .


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Atuar como referência funcional nos processos de PCP e Manufatura do Protheus ;
  • Implantar, parametrizar e sustentar processos relacionados ao SIGAPCP ;
  • Analisar e solucionar chamados de média e alta complexidade relacionados aos processos produtivos;
  • Analisar cenários de planejamento e controle da produção ;
  • Atuar com processos de MRP e necessidades de materiais ;
  • Analisar e parametrizar Ordens de Produção ;
  • Analisar estruturas, componentes e informações utilizadas no processo produtivo;
  • Avaliar impactos das movimentações de produção nos estoques e custos ;
  • Apoiar processos relacionados ao desenvolvimento e manutenção de produtos;
  • Analisar processos de inspeção e qualidade relacionados ao recebimento de materiais;
  • Identificar inconsistências entre os processos de negócio e a parametrização do Protheus;
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos e desenho de soluções funcionais;
  • Apoiar projetos de implantação, melhorias e evolução do ERP;
  • Participar de testes, homologações e validações junto aos usuários;
  • Elaborar documentação funcional e apoiar a capacitação dos usuários;
  • Interagir com equipes técnicas/desenvolvimento para especificação de customizações e correções;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto aos clientes, propondo melhorias nos processos de manufatura.


REQUISITOS – CONHECIMENTOS EM PROTHEUS


SIGAPCP – PCP / MANUFATURA

Domínio funcional do SIGAPCP , incluindo conhecimentos em:

  • Planejamento e Controle da Produção;
  • MRP – Material Requirements Planning;
  • Ordens de Produção;
  • Necessidades de produção;
  • Planejamento de materiais;
  • Estrutura de produtos e componentes;
  • Roteiros e processos produtivos;
  • Apontamentos de produção;
  • Consumo de materiais;
  • Movimentações relacionadas à produção;
  • Encerramento de Ordens de Produção;
  • Parametrizações do módulo;
  • Análise de inconsistências nos processos produtivos;
  • Integrações do PCP com estoque, produtos e custos.


SIGAEST – ESTOQUE / CUSTOS

Conhecimento dos processos de:

  • Gestão de estoques;
  • Movimentação de materiais;
  • Entradas e saídas de estoque;
  • Consumo de matérias-primas;
  • Movimentações provenientes da produção;
  • Saldos e custos;
  • Formação e análise de custos;
  • Integração entre estoque, produção e custos;
  • Impactos das movimentações do PCP nos estoques.


SIGADPR – DESENVOLVIMENTO DE PRODUTOS

Conhecimento funcional dos processos relacionados a:

  • Cadastro e manutenção de produtos;
  • Estrutura de produtos / BOM;
  • Componentes;
  • Revisões e alterações de produtos;
  • Informações utilizadas pelo processo produtivo;
  • Integração entre desenvolvimento de produtos e PCP.


SIGAQIE – INSPEÇÃO DE ENTRADA / QUALIDADE

Conhecimento dos processos relacionados a:

  • Inspeção de entrada;
  • Controle de qualidade de materiais recebidos;
  • Processos de inspeção;
  • Aprovação e reprovação de materiais;
  • Integração entre qualidade, estoque e demais processos do ERP.


⭐ DIFERENCIAIS

Será considerado um diferencial possuir conhecimento em outros módulos e processos integrados ao ambiente de manufatura do Protheus, principalmente:

SIGACOM – Compras

SIGAFAT – Faturamento

SIGAFIS – Fiscal

SIGACTB – Contábil

SIGAFIN – Financeiro

Conhecimento de ADVPL e capacidade de interpretar customizações existentes;

Experiência em projetos de implantação ou roll-out do TOTVS Protheus ;

Experiência em ambientes industriais e processos de manufatura;

Experiência em levantamento e especificação de requisitos funcionais;

Conhecimento de integrações entre os módulos de manufatura do Protheus.


Não é necessário dominar todos os módulos do Protheus. O principal requisito é possuir forte experiência em PCP/Manufatura, especialmente no SIGAPCP, com conhecimento dos processos integrados de estoque, custos, produtos e qualidade.


SOBRE A SENIORIDADE


A vaga está aberta para profissionais de nível PLENO ou SÊNIOR .

Buscamos principalmente profissionais que já tenham atuado na prática com TOTVS Protheus em ambientes de manufatura , seja em consultoria, implantação, sustentação ou dentro de empresas industriais.

Profissionais com perfil Sênior e experiência diferenciada em SIGAPCP e processos de manufatura também serão avaliados.

Para profissionais com maior senioridade e experiência compatível com a posição, poderemos avaliar uma negociação diferenciada de acordo com o perfil apresentado .


🚀 PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS


Procuramos alguém que vá além de simplesmente conhecer as telas do Protheus.

Queremos um profissional que consiga:


Entender o processo industrial → identificar o problema → analisar o Protheus → encontrar a causa → propor a solução → parametrizar/testar → acompanhar a entrega.


Se você possui experiência sólida em PCP/Manufatura no TOTVS Protheus e gosta de atuar de forma consultiva na solução de problemas e evolução dos processos dos clientes, queremos conhecer você.


Envie seu currículo para participar do nosso processo seletivo.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM PCP / MANUFATURA – TOTVS PROTHEUS
description:

Estamos buscando um profissional Pleno ou Sênior, com sólida experiência em TOTVS Protheus , para atuar com PCP, manufatura, implantação, parametrização, sustentação e atendimento consultivo a clientes .


Buscamos um profissional que tenha forte domínio dos processos de planejamento e controle da produção dentro do Protheus , sendo capaz de analisar cenários, identificar inconsistências, realizar parametrizações e propor soluções funcionais para os desafios dos clientes.


Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido

Presencial: 2 dias por semana

Atuação: Suporte, implantação, sustentação e consultoria em clientes


FOCO DA VAGA


O principal foco desta posição será atuar nos módulos de Manufatura do TOTVS Protheus , especialmente:


SIGAPCP – PCP / Planejamento e Controle da Produção

SIGAEST – Estoque / Custos

SIGADPR – Desenvolvimento de Produtos

SIGAQIE – Inspeção de Entrada / Qualidade


Buscamos um profissional com capacidade de compreender todo o fluxo produtivo , desde a estruturação do produto e seus componentes, passando pelo planejamento e execução da produção, movimentação dos estoques e controles relacionados à qualidade.

O profissional deverá atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o processo do cliente, identificando a causa dos problemas e propondo a melhor solução dentro do ecossistema TOTVS Protheus .


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Atuar como referência funcional nos processos de PCP e Manufatura do Protheus ;
  • Implantar, parametrizar e sustentar processos relacionados ao SIGAPCP ;
  • Analisar e solucionar chamados de média e alta complexidade relacionados aos processos produtivos;
  • Analisar cenários de planejamento e controle da produção ;
  • Atuar com processos de MRP e necessidades de materiais ;
  • Analisar e parametrizar Ordens de Produção ;
  • Analisar estruturas, componentes e informações utilizadas no processo produtivo;
  • Avaliar impactos das movimentações de produção nos estoques e custos ;
  • Apoiar processos relacionados ao desenvolvimento e manutenção de produtos;
  • Analisar processos de inspeção e qualidade relacionados ao recebimento de materiais;
  • Identificar inconsistências entre os processos de negócio e a parametrização do Protheus;
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos e desenho de soluções funcionais;
  • Apoiar projetos de implantação, melhorias e evolução do ERP;
  • Participar de testes, homologações e validações junto aos usuários;
  • Elaborar documentação funcional e apoiar a capacitação dos usuários;
  • Interagir com equipes técnicas/desenvolvimento para especificação de customizações e correções;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto aos clientes, propondo melhorias nos processos de manufatura.


REQUISITOS – CONHECIMENTOS EM PROTHEUS


SIGAPCP – PCP / MANUFATURA

Domínio funcional do SIGAPCP , incluindo conhecimentos em:

  • Planejamento e Controle da Produção;
  • MRP – Material Requirements Planning;
  • Ordens de Produção;
  • Necessidades de produção;
  • Planejamento de materiais;
  • Estrutura de produtos e componentes;
  • Roteiros e processos produtivos;
  • Apontamentos de produção;
  • Consumo de materiais;
  • Movimentações relacionadas à produção;
  • Encerramento de Ordens de Produção;
  • Parametrizações do módulo;
  • Análise de inconsistências nos processos produtivos;
  • Integrações do PCP com estoque, produtos e custos.


SIGAEST – ESTOQUE / CUSTOS

Conhecimento dos processos de:

  • Gestão de estoques;
  • Movimentação de materiais;
  • Entradas e saídas de estoque;
  • Consumo de matérias-primas;
  • Movimentações provenientes da produção;
  • Saldos e custos;
  • Formação e análise de custos;
  • Integração entre estoque, produção e custos;
  • Impactos das movimentações do PCP nos estoques.


SIGADPR – DESENVOLVIMENTO DE PRODUTOS

Conhecimento funcional dos processos relacionados a:

  • Cadastro e manutenção de produtos;
  • Estrutura de produtos / BOM;
  • Componentes;
  • Revisões e alterações de produtos;
  • Informações utilizadas pelo processo produtivo;
  • Integração entre desenvolvimento de produtos e PCP.

title: Estagiário jurídico
description:
Descrição da empresa Soares Costa Advocacia é um escritório jurídico dedicado à prestação de serviços de alta qualidade para clientes de diferentes setores. O foco está em oferecer atendimento personalizado com análise cuidadosa de cada caso e atuação técnica consistente. A equipe valoriza ética profissional responsabilidade e atualização constante em relação às mudanças na legislação. O ambiente de trabalho incentiva aprendizado contínuo colaboração entre equipes e desenvolvimento de novas trajetórias na área jurídica.

Descrição do cargo O Estagiário atuará em regime de 6 horas diárias em modalidade presencial no escritório localizado em belém Pa. No dia a dia irá auxiliar na elaboração e revisão de petições contratos pareceres e outros documentos jurídicos bem como na organização de arquivos físicos e digitais. Será responsável por realizar pesquisas de legislação jurisprudência e doutrina apoiar na preparação de relatórios e acompanhar prazos processuais sob supervisão da equipe. O cargo também envolve contato com clientes para coleta de informações acompanhamento de demandas e apoio em rotinas administrativas relacionadas à área jurídica sempre com orientação das pessoas advogadas responsáveis.

Qualificações

  • Estar cursando a partir do 3º semestre do curso de direito em turno vespertino ou noturno.


O que oferecemos:

  • Bolsa auxílio de meio salário Mínimo
  • Plano de carreira e possibilidade de ascenção na carreira
  • Vale transporte

title: Customer Success
description:
About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is an embedded product design partner for early-stage SaaS and AI startups based in the United States. We help founders improve product clarity, user experience, and go-to-market execution through senior design thinking combined with fast, high-quality execution.

We partner closely with ambitious startup teams to transform complex ideas into intuitive products, compelling narratives, and scalable digital experiences. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, design excellence, and business growth.


THE ROLE

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they get maximum value

from our compliance solutions while supporting smooth internal operations. You will work at the

intersection of client relationship management, process optimization, and regulatory knowledge —

making this an ideal position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.


THE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Success
  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for a portfolio of clients, building trusted long-term

relationships

  • Onboard new clients by guiding them through platform setup, training, and initial compliance

workflows

  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and health assessments to track client

satisfaction and product adoption

  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and develop retention strategies in collaboration with

Sales and Product teams

  • Gather and synthesize client feedback to inform product roadmap and service improvements

Operations & Process Support

  • Support internal operational processes including workflow documentation, project tracking,

and reporting

  • Maintain accurate client data and interaction records in the CRM system (Notion)
  • Assist in the development and refinement of SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge base content
  • Monitor deliverables and deadlines on behalf of clients, flagging risks proactively.
  • Compliance Support
  • Develop a working understanding of the regulatory frameworks relevant to our clients (e.g.,

US and International entity compliance)

  • Help complete orders for compliance related services such as business formations and

Annual filings ect.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or operations
  • Exceptional written and verbal (English) communication skills with the ability to explain

complex concepts clearly

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and client accounts

simultaneously

  • Proficiency with Notion, Google and project management platforms is a plus
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a high attention to detail
  • Experience supporting onboarding or implementation processes for software products


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will play a key role in shaping how an ambitious startup design partner communicates its value to the world.

Today, our biggest bottleneck is not delivery — it’s clarity. We are looking for someone who can help sharpen our story, accelerate our sales process, and build unmistakable positioning in a highly competitive market.

  • You’ll work directly with founders, influence business strategy, and have meaningful ownership over how Foundey grows, communicates, and wins clients.

title: Customer Success
description:
About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is an embedded product design partner for early-stage SaaS and AI startups based in the United States. We help founders improve product clarity, user experience, and go-to-market execution through senior design thinking combined with fast, high-quality execution.

We partner closely with ambitious startup teams to transform complex ideas into intuitive products, compelling narratives, and scalable digital experiences. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, design excellence, and business growth.


THE ROLE

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they get maximum value

from our compliance solutions while supporting smooth internal operations. You will work at the

intersection of client relationship management, process optimization, and regulatory knowledge —

making this an ideal position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.


THE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Success
  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for a portfolio of clients, building trusted long-term

relationships

  • Onboard new clients by guiding them through platform setup, training, and initial compliance

workflows

  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and health assessments to track client

satisfaction and product adoption

  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and develop retention strategies in collaboration with

Sales and Product teams

  • Gather and synthesize client feedback to inform product roadmap and service improvements

Operations & Process Support

  • Support internal operational processes including workflow documentation, project tracking,

and reporting

  • Maintain accurate client data and interaction records in the CRM system (Notion)
  • Assist in the development and refinement of SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge base content
  • Monitor deliverables and deadlines on behalf of clients, flagging risks proactively.
  • Compliance Support
  • Develop a working understanding of the regulatory frameworks relevant to our clients (e.g.,

US and International entity compliance)

  • Help complete orders for compliance related services such as business formations and

Annual filings ect.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or operations
  • Exceptional written and verbal (English) communication skills with the ability to explain

complex concepts clearly

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and client accounts

simultaneously

  • Proficiency with Notion, Google and project management platforms is a plus
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a high attention to detail
  • Experience supporting onboarding or implementation processes for software products

title: Bilingual Customer Service Agent
description:
Job Description: Monday to Saturday. 44 hours per week. PJ. NIGHT SHIFT.


We are looking for a remote Bilingual Customer Service Agent to handle inbound and outbound phone call and email communications in both languages. This role focuses on assisting customers with questions related to delivery, installation, scheduling, and general order support, as well as proactively reaching out to customers when needed.


Responsibilities:

  • - Answer inbound phone calls and respond to customer emails in both languages
  • - Make outbound phone calls and send emails to customers for follow-ups, confirmations, and updates
  • Route logistics
  • - Provide accurate information about delivery and installation timelines
  • - Schedule, confirm, and update appointments as needed
  • - Resolve customer questions and issues in a professional and timely manner
  • - Document interactions and update customer records accurately
  • - Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery


Requirements:

  • - Previous experience in customer service or call center support
  • - Fluent verbal and written communication skills in two languages
  • - Comfortable handling inbound and outbound calls and emails throughout the day
  • - Organized, detail-oriented, and reliable
  • - Ability to remain calm and professional in fast-paced situations
  • - Basic computer skills (email, scheduling systems, CRM preferred)


What we offer:

- Training and ongoing support

- Growth opportunities within the company.


Please submit your CV in English.

title: Analista de Gestão de Pessoas e Cultura
description:
Analista de Gestão de Pessoas e Cultura | SalesRock


Procuramos uma pessoa comunicativa, empática e estratégica para fortalecer nosso time de Gente e Gestão. Você será responsável por cultivar uma cultura inclusiva, impulsionar o engajamento e garantir que a jornada de cada colaborador na SalesRock seja incrível do onboarding ao desenvolvimento contínuo.


Suas Principais Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o processo de acolhimento e integração (onboarding) de novos talentos.
  • Planejar e executar ações contínuas de engajamento, clima organizacional e endomarketing.
  • Acompanhar a jornada do colaborador através de pesquisas de clima, reuniões de 1-on-1 e entrevistas de desligamento.
  • Dar suporte no desenvolvimento e na implementação de programas de treinamento e liderança.
  • Ser um ponto de apoio ativo na mediação de conflitos e na promoção de um ambiente psicologicamente seguro e diverso.
  • Apoiar a mensuração de indicadores da área (rotatividade, absenteísmo, eNPS) para propor melhorias contínuas.


O Que Buscamos (Requisitos)


  • Experiência prévia na área de Recursos Humanos, com foco em Gestão de Pessoas, Cultura ou Desenvolvimento Organizacional.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, além de escuta ativa.
  • Habilidade para transitar entre a execução operacional e a análise estratégica de cultura.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de gerenciar projetos internos de forma autônoma.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência prévia no segmento de tecnologia ou startups.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de avaliação de desempenho e PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual).


O Que Oferecemos


  • Modelo de trabalho
  • Salário compatível com o mercado.
  • Ambiente dinâmico com oportunidade real de impacto na cultura da empresa.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.

  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Criador de Conteúdo Sem Experiência :: Apostas Esportivas & iGaming
description:
SOBRE A VAGA


A Doppa conecta pessoas que querem se tornar criadoras de conteúdo a marcas licenciadas do setor de apostas esportivas e cassino online (iGaming), um dos segmentos mais aquecidos do mercado digital brasileiro hoje.


Estamos buscando pessoas sem experiência prévia em criação de conteúdo que queiram aprender, na prática, a produzir vídeos curtos para redes sociais e ser remuneradas por isso desde o primeiro vídeo.


Não exigimos portfólio, equipamento profissional ou seguidores. Exigimos disposição para aprender e consistência.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?


Gravar vídeos curtos (formato reels/shorts) usando apenas um celular, seguindo as diretrizes fornecidas pela Doppa.


Produzir conteúdo para marcas parceiras devidamente licenciadas pela SPA/MF (Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas).


Evoluir dentro da trilha de progressão da Doppa conforme volume e qualidade dos vídeos.


PONTOS DE ATENÇÃO


É imprescindível ter mais do que 18 anos para se candidatar.


Trabalhamos exclusivamente com operadores licenciados pela SPA/MF e seguimos rigorosamente a Portaria SPA/MF nº 1.231/2024, que regula a publicidade do setor de apostas no Brasil.


Toda comunicação produzida na Doppa segue diretrizes claras de transparência: identificação de parceria, exibição de licença e proibição de qualquer promessa de retorno garantido.


Não trabalhamos com discurso de \"ganhar dinheiro fácil\". Trabalhamos com formação real de criadores dentro de um setor regulamentado, sério e em expansão.
