title: Account Executive - Growth LATAM/BR
description:
ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE — CREATOR GROWTH

LATAM & Brazil


Sobre Salduu

Salduu es una plataforma de ecommerce y pagos para creadores de productos digitales en Latinoamérica.

Nuestra misión es proporcionar a los creadores la infraestructura necesaria para comercializar, cobrar y hacer crecer sus productos digitales, entregándoles una experiencia simple, flexible y orientada a sus necesidades de negocio.

Actualmente nos encontramos en una etapa de crecimiento y expansión comercial, con especial foco en Latinoamérica y Brasil. En esta etapa estamos fortaleciendo nuestra organización comercial y construyendo procesos que nos permitan crecer de manera consistente y sostenible.

Para ello, buscamos incorporar un Account Executive (AE) que tenga un rol central en la adquisición y desarrollo de nuevos clientes.


El desafío

El principal desafío comercial de Salduu es desarrollar una cartera amplia y sostenible de creadores digitales.


Nuestro foco está especialmente puesto en creadores con productos digitales validados, modelos de negocio sostenibles y potencial de crecimiento .


Queremos desarrollar relaciones comerciales de largo plazo con nuestros clientes y acompañarlos en la evolución de sus negocios, desde su incorporación a Salduu hasta el crecimiento de su volumen de ventas.


El desafío combina, por lo tanto:

  • adquisición de nuevos clientes;
  • ventas consultivas;
  • desarrollo de cuentas;
  • crecimiento del GMV;
  • comprensión profunda del negocio de cada creador;
  • y construcción de conocimiento comercial que permita escalar el equipo.


Responsabilidades


1. Adquisición y cierre de nuevos clientes

Serás responsable de gestionar oportunidades comerciales desde la reunión inicial hasta el cierre.

Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán:

  • Realizar reuniones comerciales con creadores y negocios digitales.
  • Comprender su modelo de negocio, productos, audiencia, canales de adquisición y necesidades.
  • Identificar oportunidades donde Salduu pueda generar valor.
  • Preparar y realizar presentaciones y demostraciones de la plataforma.
  • Desarrollar propuestas comerciales.
  • Gestionar objeciones y negociaciones.
  • Realizar seguimiento sistemático del pipeline.
  • Gestionar el proceso de cierre hasta la incorporación del cliente.


2. Desarrollo y crecimiento de cuentas

La relación comercial no termina con el cierre.

El AE será responsable de desarrollar una relación de largo plazo con sus principales cuentas y detectar oportunidades para incrementar su actividad dentro de Salduu.


Esto puede incluir:

  • activación de nuevos productos;
  • crecimiento del volumen de ventas;
  • expansión hacia nuevos mercados;
  • utilización de nuevas funcionalidades;
  • nuevos métodos de pago;
  • identificación de oportunidades de crecimiento.

El objetivo es desarrollar clientes que tengan una relación sostenible y creciente con Salduu.


3. Desarrollo del Sales Playbook

Esta posición tendrá además un componente importante de construcción comercial .

Salduu está desarrollando y perfeccionando su metodología de ventas. Por lo tanto, no buscamos simplemente incorporar a una persona para ejecutar un proceso completamente definido.


El AE trabajará directamente con el fundador y con el equipo para:

  • definir y perfeccionar nuestro ICP;
  • identificar los perfiles de creadores con mayor potencial;
  • desarrollar criterios de calificación;
  • identificar las principales razones de compra;
  • desarrollar y perfeccionar el proceso de discovery;
  • documentar objeciones y respuestas;
  • analizar oportunidades ganadas y perdidas;
  • identificar patrones de comportamiento;
  • mejorar continuamente el proceso comercial;
  • y convertir estos aprendizajes en un Sales Playbook replicable y escalable .

La expectativa es que puedas aprender del mercado, documentar ese aprendizaje y contribuir a convertirlo en procesos comerciales .


4. Trabajo conjunto con el fundador

Durante esta etapa trabajarás de manera cercana con el fundador de Salduu.


Esto significa participar en:

  • definición de estrategia comercial;
  • análisis de segmentos;
  • experimentación con nuevos enfoques comerciales;
  • revisión de resultados;
  • definición de prioridades;
  • análisis de feedback de clientes;
  • evolución del Sales Playbook.

Buscamos una persona que pueda aportar criterio y propuestas, pero que al mismo tiempo entienda que la estrategia y los procesos se irán perfeccionando a partir de la experiencia real del mercado.


Perfil que buscamosExperiencia


Buscamos profesionales con:

  • 3+ años de experiencia en ventas B2B, SaaS, fintech, ecommerce, payments, marketplaces, creator economy o negocios digitales.
  • Experiencia demostrable en cierre de negocios.
  • Experiencia gestionando pipeline comercial.
  • Experiencia en ventas consultivas.
  • Experiencia en startups, scale-ups o ambientes de rápido crecimiento será altamente valorada.


Competencias

Buscamos una persona:

  • orientada fuertemente a resultados;
  • con capacidad demostrada de cierre;
  • consultiva y orientada al cliente;
  • con capacidad para comprender rápidamente diferentes modelos de negocio;
  • analítica y estructurada;
  • autónoma y organizada;
  • capaz de trabajar en ambientes dinámicos;
  • con iniciativa para proponer y experimentar;
  • abierta al aprendizaje y al feedback;
  • capaz de transformar aprendizajes individuales en procesos;
  • con interés por desarrollar eventualmente responsabilidades de liderazgo comercial.


Mentalidad

Esta posición requiere comodidad trabajando en una empresa en etapa de crecimiento.

El producto, los procesos y las prioridades continuarán evolucionando.

Buscamos una persona que pueda trabajar eficazmente en este contexto, manteniendo foco en los resultados y siendo capaz de distinguir entre:

  • una necesidad real del cliente;
  • una oportunidad comercial;
  • un requerimiento puntual;
  • y una decisión de producto que debe evaluarse estratégicamente.

Valoramos especialmente la capacidad de vender con el producto disponible, identificar oportunidades de mejora y transmitir feedback de manera estructurada .


Idiomas

Español: fluido.

Portugués: altamente valorado y preferentemente fluido.

Brasil es un mercado prioritario para Salduu, por lo que la capacidad de desarrollar conversaciones comerciales en portugués será considerada una ventaja significativa.


Modalidad

100% remoto.

Buscamos candidatos principalmente en Latinoamérica y Brasil.


Compensación

  • Salario competitivo de mercado.
  • Componente variable asociado a resultados.
  • Esquema diseñado para alinear crecimiento comercial con la generación de negocio sostenible para Salduu.

La estructura específica de compensación será conversada durante el proceso.


Qué ofrecemos

  • Incorporarte a una startup tecnológica en etapa de crecimiento.
  • Trabajo directo con el fundador.
  • Alta autonomía y capacidad de influencia.
  • Participación en la construcción de la estrategia y metodología comercial.
  • Exposición a ecommerce, fintech, pagos y creator economy.
  • Posibilidad de evolucionar hacia posiciones de liderazgo comercial a medida que crezca el equipo.
  • Trabajo 100% remoto.


¿Por qué Salduu?

Estamos buscando construir una organización comercial que pueda crecer mucho más allá de los resultados individuales de cada vendedor.

Por eso esta posición combina ejecución comercial, aprendizaje y construcción de procesos .

Si te interesa vender, pero también entender profundamente a tus clientes, descubrir patrones y participar en la construcción de una metodología comercial escalable, nos interesa conocerte.


Postula para conversar con nosotros.

Esta posición tendrá además un componente importante de construcción comercial .

Salduu está desarrollando y perfeccionando su metodología de ventas. Por lo tanto, no buscamos simplemente incorporar a una persona para ejecutar un proceso completamente definido.


El AE trabajará directamente con el fundador y con el equipo para:

  • definir y perfeccionar nuestro ICP;
  • identificar los perfiles de creadores con mayor potencial;
  • desarrollar criterios de calificación;
  • identificar las principales razones de compra;
  • desarrollar y perfeccionar el proceso de discovery;
  • documentar objeciones y respuestas;
  • analizar oportunidades ganadas y perdidas;
  • identificar patrones de comportamiento;
  • mejorar continuamente el proceso comercial;
  • y convertir estos aprendizajes en un Sales Playbook replicable y escalable .

La expectativa es que puedas aprender del mercado, documentar ese aprendizaje y contribuir a convertirlo en procesos comerciales .


4. Trabajo conjunto con el fundador

Durante esta etapa trabajarás de manera cercana con el fundador de Salduu.


Esto significa participar en:

  • definición de estrategia comercial;
  • análisis de segmentos;
  • experimentación con nuevos enfoques comerciales;
  • revisión de resultados;
  • definición de prioridades;
  • análisis de feedback de clientes;
  • evolución del Sales Playbook.

Buscamos una persona que pueda aportar criterio y propuestas, pero que al mismo tiempo entienda que la estrategia y los procesos se irán perfeccionando a partir de la experiencia real del mercado.


Perfil que buscamosExperiencia


Buscamos profesionales con:

  • 3+ años de experiencia en ventas B2B, SaaS, fintech, ecommerce, payments, marketplaces, creator economy o negocios digitales.
  • Experiencia demostrable en cierre de negocios.
  • Experiencia gestionando pipeline comercial.
  • Experiencia en ventas consultivas.
  • Experiencia en startups, scale-ups o ambientes de rápido crecimiento será altamente valorada.


Competencias

Buscamos una persona:

  • orientada fuertemente a resultados;
  • con capacidad demostrada de cierre;
  • consultiva y orientada al cliente;
  • con capacidad para comprender rápidamente diferentes modelos de negocio;
  • analítica y estructurada;
  • autónoma y organizada;
  • capaz de trabajar en ambientes dinámicos;
  • con iniciativa para proponer y experimentar;
  • abierta al aprendizaje y al feedback;
  • capaz de transformar aprendizajes individuales en procesos;
  • con interés por desarrollar eventualmente responsabilidades de liderazgo comercial.


Mentalidad

Esta posición requiere comodidad trabajando en una empresa en etapa de crecimiento.

El producto, los procesos y las prioridades continuarán evolucionando.

Buscamos una persona que pueda trabajar eficazmente en este contexto, manteniendo foco en los resultados y siendo capaz de distinguir entre:

  • una necesidad real del cliente;
  • una oportunidad comercial;
  • un requerimiento puntual;
  • y una decisión de producto que debe evaluarse estratégicamente.

Valoramos especialmente la capacidad de vender con el producto disponible, identificar oportunidades de mejora y transmitir feedback de manera estructurada .


Idiomas

Español: fluido.

Portugués: altamente valorado y preferentemente fluido.

Brasil es un mercado prioritario para Salduu, por lo que la capacidad de desarrollar conversaciones comerciales en portugués será considerada una ventaja significativa.


Modalidad

100% remoto.

Buscamos candidatos principalmente en Latinoamérica y Brasil.


Compensación

  • Salario competitivo de mercado.
  • Componente variable asociado a resultados.
  • Esquema diseñado para alinear crecimiento comercial con la generación de negocio sostenible para Salduu.

La estructura específica de compensación será conversada durante el proceso.


Qué ofrecemos

  • Incorporarte a una startup tecnológica en etapa de crecimiento.
  • Trabajo directo con el fundador.
  • Alta autonomía y capacidad de influencia.
  • Participación en la construcción de la estrategia y metodología comercial.
  • Exposición a ecommerce, fintech, pagos y creator economy.
  • Posibilidad de evolucionar hacia posiciones de liderazgo comercial a medida que crezca el equipo.
  • Trabajo 100% remoto.


¿Por qué Salduu?

Estamos buscando construir una organización comercial que pueda crecer mucho más allá de los resultados individuales de cada vendedor.

Por eso esta posición combina ejecución comercial, aprendizaje y construcción de procesos .

Si te interesa vender, pero también entender profundamente a tus clientes, descubrir patrones y participar en la construcción de una metodología comercial escalable, nos interesa conocerte.


Postula para conversar con nosotros.

title: Data Specialist (with Advanced English)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


About the Role:

We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!


As Our Data Specialist, you will:

  • Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it.
  • Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here.
  • Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world.
  • Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and PySpark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors
  • You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter
  • You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized
  • You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company


What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.



We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.




Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior / Liderança Técnica LATAM
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior / Liderança Técnica LATAM


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: PJ full time


Buscamos por um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar como liderança técnica de Engenharia de Dados para LATAM, sendo referência nas iniciativas da região. A pessoa apoiará times distribuídos, direcionará soluções escaláveis e atuará como ponte entre produto, negócio, engenharia e plataforma.


Responsabilidades

– Atuar como referência técnica de Engenharia de Dados para LATAM/LAS.

– Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de alta complexidade, sem necessidade de gestão direta.

– Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar pipelines ETL/ELT em grande escala.

– Desenvolver soluções em Databricks com PySpark, Spark SQL e Delta Lake.

– Apoiar decisões de arquitetura, governança, qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.

– Realizar code reviews, design reviews e disseminar boas práticas.

– Mentorar engenheiros de dados e apoiar a evolução técnica dos times.


Requisitos

– Mais de 5 anos de experiência em Engenharia de Dados.

– Experiência como referência técnica, Tech Lead informal, Staff Engineer ou papel equivalente.

– Espanhol avançado para atuação diária com países LATAM.

– Forte experiência com Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Python, SQL e Delta Lake.

– Experiência com Data Lakehouse, arquitetura Medallion e pipelines batch/streaming.

– Vivência com Azure, preferencialmente ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory ou Databricks Workflows.

– Experiência com APIs REST, Git, Pull Requests, CI/CD, governança, qualidade e observabilidade de dados.


Diferenciais

– Unity Catalog, Data Mesh, Airflow, Terraform/IaC, DataOps, FinOps, GenAI aplicada a dados ou certificações Azure/Databricks.

title: Oracle PL/SQL Lead - 100% Remote
description:
Oracle PL/SQL - 100% Remote

Job Location: Remote in Mexico/Brazil

Job Type: Contract


Job Description:


We are seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Oracle Database Administration to manage, optimize, and support complex Oracle database environments. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in database performance tuning, administration, and cloud migration, while ensuring security, reliability, and compliance.


Key Responsibilities


Administer and maintain Oracle database environments to ensure high availability, reliability, and optimal performance.

Perform advanced DBA tasks including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and monitoring.

Conduct backups, recovery, and disaster recovery planning/implementation.

Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing, and execution plan analysis.

Collaborate with development teams to support application/database requirements and resolve issues.

Implement and maintain security, compliance, and data integrity standards across all environments.

Lead migration and upgrade projects, including on-premises to cloud transitions.

Document configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure operational consistency.

Stay current with latest Oracle database technologies, features, and best practices.


Roles and Expectations


  • Design, develop, and optimize complex SQL queries and PL/SQL procedures.
  • Perform in-depth troubleshooting and performance tuning for databases and queries.
  • Analyze execution plans and recommend strategies for query/database optimization.
  • Collaborate effectively with DBAs, data architects, and analysts to implement optimization and governance strategies.
  • Monitor database performance metrics and implement proactive improvements.
  • Drive data migration and modernization initiatives, with a strong focus on cloud adoption.
  • Establish and enforce best practices for governance, security, and compliance.
  • Act as a senior technical resource, participating in interviews and technical assessments for Oracle DBA candidates.

title: Business Analyst Trainee — Marketing Automation & AI
description:
Type: 90‑day, full‑time remote internship/trainee program (paid)

Pay: USD $1,000 / month

Contract: Independent contractor (Canada‑based company)

Future: Outstanding interns may receive a full‑time offer.

Non-negotiable requirement: Advanced English


Ready to Apply? We value thoughtful applications over quick submissions. Please send short introduction video to j. Include any relevant experience or examples of your work that demonstrate your skills in building things.


Alternatively, you will receive an automated email to prepare a one-way video interview as the first step of the hiring process.


What You’ll Do

  • Build from zero: Stand up internal marketing‑agency systems, analytics stacks, and repeatable processes—often with no existing playbook.
  • Automate & optimize: Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and deploy no‑code/low‑code, AI, or integration tools (Cursor, Replit, Zapier, Make, GPT, etc.) to streamline them.
  • Turn data into insight: Design dashboards and translate numbers into actionable narratives for stakeholders.
  • Ship & educate: Draft launch content, craft go‑to‑market strategies, and create user‑friendly training to ensure adoption.


You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • Learn fast: You welcome constructive pushback and treat every project as a chance to sharpen your craft.
  • Love variety: Each day’s challenges differ—expect context switching and rapid iteration.
  • Communicate crisply: Advanced written and spoken English is non‑negotiable.
  • Stay curious: New tech doesn’t scare you; you experiment until it bends to the problem.


Core Skills…

  • Professional/Bilingual proficiency in English. All business activities require an advanced level of English
  • Business writing & stakeholder persuasion
  • Familiarity with no‑code / AI automation platforms
  • Data literacy & visualization sense
  • Project management fundamentals

title: Brand Operator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a Brand Operator to join our growing team! You’re probably thinking, “Wtf is a Brand Operator?” Keep reading.


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency, but here’s the thing most agencies won’t tell you: having a website isn’t a strategy. Neither is posting on Instagram three times a week. A blog without a traffic plan is a diary. A newsletter nobody opens is a chore. Every tactic we run exists to answer one question: how does this move someone from ”never heard of you” to “shut up and take my money”? That’s the job. Blogs feed SEO. SEO feeds traffic. Traffic feeds the funnel. The funnel feeds revenue. If a tactic doesn’t connect to that chain, we don’t run it just to look busy. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription, minus the shit that doesn’t get anyone anywhere.


Purpose of the Role


The Brand Operator combines client relationship ownership with hands-on marketing production. You are the client’s main point of contact and one of the people actually making the work happen. This role exists because most agencies force clients to choose between “someone who understands your brand” and “someone who can execute.” We don’t think that tradeoff should exist, and neither will you.


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Multifaceted, someone who steps up to the challenge
  • Proactive, always thinking about the needs of a client before they are
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful — you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, specifically) as part of your daily workflow as a way to move faster and think better


The Skill Requirements


You need real, hands-on proficiency in at least 3–4 of the following:


  • Short-form video editing (Reels, TikTok, etc)
  • Social media strategy, content creation, and scheduling
  • Newsletter writing and editing
  • Brand strategy and positioning
  • Copywriting (web, ads, email, social)
  • Design fundamentals (Canva, Figma, or similar)
  • Basic analytics and reporting (knowing what a number means, not just where to find it)


Coordination skills alone will not meet the bar for this role. We already know you can manage a project. We need to know what you can build.


Main Objectives


1. Client Relationship Ownership

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, understanding their goals well enough to make calls without needing a meeting first
  • Run regular check-ins, reviews, and strategy conversations that actually move the account forward, not just status updates
  • Translate client goals into a point of view, not just a task list


2. Hands-On Production

  • Personally execute against your core skills (video, social, newsletter, copy, brand, design, wherever you excel)
  • Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up ideation, drafting, and iteration. We want to see how you think with AI as a collaborator, not just how fast you can type a prompt
  • Maintain a quality bar on your own output before it goes to review, not after


3. Internal Collaboration

  • Work with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other Operators to fill gaps outside your core skills
  • Keep project tools (ClickUp and similar) current and accurate without needing to be chased
  • Give and receive direct feedback — we skip the sandwich method here


4. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

  • Help shape brand and marketing strategy for your accounts, not just execute against someone else’s plan
  • Continuously look for workflow improvements, especially ones involving AI, that let you do more without more hours
  • Manage multiple accounts without letting them quietly rot


Important Notes

  • Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Mon day to Friday.
  • The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional .


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency, but here’s the thing most agencies won’t tell you: having a website isn’t a strategy. Neither is posting on Instagram three times a week. A blog without a traffic plan is a diary. A newsletter nobody opens is a chore. Every tactic we run exists to answer one question: how does this move someone from ”never heard of you” to “shut up and take my money”? That’s the job. Blogs feed SEO. SEO feeds traffic. Traffic feeds the funnel. The funnel feeds revenue. If a tactic doesn’t connect to that chain, we don’t run it just to look busy. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription, minus the shit that doesn’t get anyone anywhere.


Purpose of the Role


The Brand Operator combines client relationship ownership with hands-on marketing production. You are the client’s main point of contact and one of the people actually making the work happen. This role exists because most agencies force clients to choose between “someone who understands your brand” and “someone who can execute.” We don’t think that tradeoff should exist, and neither will you.


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Multifaceted, someone who steps up to the challenge
  • Proactive, always thinking about the needs of a client before they are
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful — you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, specifically) as part of your daily workflow as a way to move faster and think better


The Skill Requirements


You need real, hands-on proficiency in at least 3–4 of the following:


  • Short-form video editing (Reels, TikTok, etc)
  • Social media strategy, content creation, and scheduling
  • Newsletter writing and editing
  • Brand strategy and positioning
  • Copywriting (web, ads, email, social)
  • Design fundamentals (Canva, Figma, or similar)
  • Basic analytics and reporting (knowing what a number means, not just where to find it)


Coordination skills alone will not meet the bar for this role. We already know you can manage a project. We need to know what you can build.


Main Objectives


1. Client Relationship Ownership

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, understanding their goals well enough to make calls without needing a meeting first
  • Run regular check-ins, reviews, and strategy conversations that actually move the account forward, not just status updates
  • Translate client goals into a point of view, not just a task list


2. Hands-On Production

  • Personally execute against your core skills (video, social, newsletter, copy, brand, design, wherever you excel)
  • Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up ideation, drafting, and iteration. We want to see how you think with AI as a collaborator, not just how fast you can type a prompt
  • Maintain a quality bar on your own output before it goes to review, not after


3. Internal Collaboration

  • Work with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other Operators to fill gaps outside your core skills
  • Keep project tools (ClickUp and similar) current and accurate without needing to be chased
  • Give and receive direct feedback — we skip the sandwich method here


4. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

  • Help shape brand and marketing strategy for your accounts, not just execute against someone else’s plan
  • Continuously look for workflow improvements, especially ones involving AI, that let you do more without more hours
  • Manage multiple accounts without letting them quietly rot


Important Notes

  • Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Mon day to Friday.
  • The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional .


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

no dia a dia a pessoa irá sugerir melhorias e redesenhar e metrificar todo o funil comercial. O projeto a princípio é temporário com duração de 90 dias, podendo ser extendido e tornado contínuo.

title: Analista de CX - Portaria
description:
We are looking for a Customer Experience Analyst based in São Paulo. As a Customer Experience Analyst, you will find solutions to the stickiest, most unique challenges faced by our guests and our team. Your objective is to deliver an outstanding customer experience to clients in Tabas Apartments, solving customers' problems to delight them. You will guarantee agility and quality of service prioritizing customers' satisfaction. Your routine requires intelligent analysis of situations and establishing processes of continuous improvement for the company.


Responsabilities:

  • Customers orders tracking;
  • Evaluation of services performed by internal and external collaborators;
  • Analytical ability to classify and develop strategic information for the areas;
  • Be entrepreneurial, not be afraid to get your hands dirty and go beyond to things rolling while helping to build the company;
  • Receiving complex inquiries from guests and then deciding the right way to resolve the issues while ensuring an excellent client experience;
  • Liaising across functions within the business to identify the origin of customer support issues and improve related processes to enhance customer experience;
  • Be process driven and help delivering an outstanding experience for our clients;
  • Participate in and help building 24/7 customer support for our clients in Tabas apartments.


THIS ROLE REQUIRES

  • Work experience in a customer service position;
  • Advanced English
  • Great communication skills- both written and verbal;
  • Ability to work on weekends when needed;
  • Bachelor’s Degree;
  • Problem-solving attitude.

  • UI scripting / technical design experience
  • Front-end game UI implementation

  • Own features from implementation through final verification

title: 11337 - Analista de Desenvolvimento Delphi
description:
Estamos recrutando Analista de Desenvolvimento Delphi Sênior para atuar em modelo PJ, 100% remoto em uma importante empresa do segmento de Saúde, atuando com sustentação, evolução e desenvolvimento de sistemas corporativos. 🚀


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de sistemas em ambientes produtivos e não produtivos;
  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes críticos, realizando análise de causa-raiz e troubleshooting;
  • Desenvolver melhorias, novas funcionalidades e projetos de inovação tecnológica;
  • Desenvolver integrações entre sistemas por meio de APIs e Webservices;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes internas e parceiros de tecnologia;
  • Contribuir com decisões de arquitetura, performance, eficiência e evolução tecnológica das aplicações.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência sólida desenvolvimento em Delphi;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e integração de sistemas;
  • Conhecimento em REST, SOAP, APIs, SQL e PL/SQL;
  • Vivência com Oracle e/ou Informix;

title: CTF Player
description:
⚠️ This is NOT a paid role.

No salary, no contract, no visas. Just a hobby team and community. Typical commitment: ~3–6 hrs/week, flexible around your life/work/school.


WHO ARE WE

  • We’re Brazil-based, but international.
  • We run weekly labs, internal scrims, and mentor newcomers.
  • PT/EN welcome.
  • Top-ranked Brazilian team on Hack The Box.
  • We live ethical hacking and CTFs, share writeups/tooling, and help each other level up.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • HTB grinds (Active/Retired), weekend CTFs, and internal scrims
  • Pair sessions, tooling sprints, and writeup contributions
  • Help keep the top BR spot and push global rankings
  • Mentor newcomers (if you like) and collaborate on notes


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Minimum HTB rank: Pro Hacker (exceptions may apply)
  • Comfortable in at least one: Web, Pwn, Reversing, Crypto, Forensics, AD/Windows, Cloud, or Mobile
  • You share knowledge: writeups, articles, tooling, notes, or past CTF placements
  • Collaborative, respectful, and can spare ~3–6 hrs/week


NICE-TO-HAVES (from “qualifications”)

  • Proficiency in ethical hacking/offensive techniques and some defense tactics
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and independence
  • Prior CTF participation is a plus; passion to keep learning is a must


WHAT WE OFFER (perks, not pay)

  • Infra & resources: internal writeups on demand for active HTB machines, shared scripts/tooling/resources
  • Identity & platform: @hackersonsteroids.org / @hos.team email, GitHub org, a blog for research & writeups and more
  • Peers: full-stack, malware/exploit devs, infra/sysadmins, mobile sec, HTB tryhards; certs across CRTO, CPTS, OSCP, eJPT, PT1, CRTA, CAPENX/CAPEN, eCPPTv3, PJPT, PWPA
  • Chill, meme-friendly culture


LINKS

  • HTB team:
  • Discord:


FINE PRINT

  • This is unpaid and volunteer-only. No salary, equity, or stipends.
  • No employment contracts, no internships, and no visa sponsorship.
  • Real life comes first—school/work/family > CTFs.
  • English or Portuguese both welcome!


If this sounds fun, apply here or join the Discord ( — see you in the next scrim!

title: Analista de Backoffice - Operações
description:
Procuramos um Analista de Backoffice para atuar na área de operações de uma empresa de comércio eletrônico com atuação internacional. O trabalho é 100% remoto, com horário fixo e dedicação exclusiva.


IMPORTANTE: esta não é uma vaga de atendimento ao cliente. O contato com o cliente é feito de forma automatizada por um sistema próprio. A função é analisar, priorizar e preparar decisões.


ATIVIDADES


- Analisar diariamente a fila de casos de pós-venda em sistema próprio, identificando os casos de risco real que precisam de decisão

- Preparar o dossiê de cada caso para aprovação da diretoria: valor, dados, histórico e justificativa objetiva

- Conferir rastreio de pedidos e acompanhar prazos de entrega junto aos fornecedores

- Cobrar fornecedores sobre despachos pendentes e escalar o que não for resolvido

- Executar pagamentos de pedidos dentro de limite e regra previamente definidos

- Sinalizar inconsistências e falhas identificadas no sistema


REQUISITOS


- Experiência em ouvidoria, SAC nível 2, backoffice de reclamações, análise de chargeback, regulação de sinistros, contas a pagar ou conciliação

- Capacidade de distinguir uma reclamação grave de uma reclamação apenas exaltada — critério para priorizar pelo risco real, e não pelo tom

- Facilidade para trabalhar dentro de sistema próprio, seguindo régua e critérios definidos

- Organização e constância na rotina diária

- Ensino médio completo (formação superior é desejável, não obrigatória)


Não é necessário conhecimento em comércio eletrônico nem em idiomas estrangeiros.


PERFIL DA VAGA


Rotina estruturada e previsível, com foco em consistência e critério. Não é uma posição de crescimento acelerado.


CONDIÇÕES


- 100% remoto

- Segunda a sexta, das 8h às 18h

- Dedicação exclusiva

- CLT ou PJ, a combinar

- Remuneração: R$ 2.200 a R$ 3.000

title: Bolsista Doutor em Engenharia - EIT Caldeiraria - Implantação de PCP | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A EIT Caldeiraria Ltda atua na fabricação e execução de soluções em caldeiraria industrial, atendendo demandas de produção e montagem com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e atendimento às necessidades operacionais dos clientes. Com forte interface entre engenharia e chão de fábrica, a empresa busca evoluir sua gestão produtiva para ganhar previsibilidade, produtividade e competitividade.

Neste projeto, a atuação será voltada à implantação de Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) para otimizar o fluxo de trabalho na caldeiraria, aumentando a eficiência operacional e reduzindo custos e prazos de entrega. A iniciativa envolve estruturar rotinas, métodos e ferramentas de planejamento, sequenciamento e acompanhamento da produção, consolidando uma base de gestão que permita melhor tomada de decisão e maior controle sobre capacidade, materiais e prazos.

Se você tem perfil analítico e interesse em atuar diretamente na melhoria de processos e gestão da produção industrial, contribuindo para resultados mensuráveis em produtividade e entrega, venha fazer parte desse desafio.

Projeto: Implantação de Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) para aumento de eficiência, redução de custos e prazos de entrega na caldeiraria industrial.

Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Industrial, Engenharia de Manufatura.

Principais Atividades:

• Diagnóstico e mapeamento do processo produtivo;

• Estruturação de dados e parâmetros de planejamento;

• Implantação das rotinas de PCP;

• Integração com compras e gestão de materiais;

• Monitoramento de indicadores e melhoria contínua;

• Padronização, documentação e treinamento;

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos:

• PCP aplicado: noções sólidas de planejamento, sequenciamento, capacidade, lead time e estoques;

• Mapeamento/diagnóstico de processo produtivo e definição de rotinas de PCP;

• Estruturação e parametrização de dados básicos;

• Excel intermediário/avançado para análises e indicadores;

• Gestão por indicadores e melhoria contínua;

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais:

• Experiência prática implantando PCP (ou reestruturação completa)

• Vivência com ERP e módulos de produção/materiais (SAP, TOTVS etc.) e/ou APS/MES

• Ferramentas Lean e qualidade (VSM, Kaizen, 5S, DMAIC, CEP)

• Integração forte com compras/suprimentos e gestão de materiais (ABC, políticas de estoque, inventário)

• Experiência com treinamento e gestão da mudança (padronização, capacitação de equipe)

Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Presencial / Paiçandu PR. Soft Skills: Autogestão, Trabalho em equipe, Autonomia, Criatividade, Ética e Responsabilidade, organização.

description:

title: Gerente de Contas Sudeste
description:
About the role

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Contas Foodservice para impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios da Kerry na Região Sudeste do Brasil por meio da gestão estratégica de distribuidores de foodservice e operadores de vending machine. Esta posição terá papel fundamental na aceleração do sell-out, expansão da base de clientes e desenvolvimento de planos de negócio sustentáveis, atuando de forma próxima aos parceiros comerciais e equipes de vendas em campo.

Além da responsabilidade comercial, o profissional liderará diretamente um colaborador, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento da equipe, execução da estratégia comercial e alcance dos objetivos de crescimento da região.

Key responsibilities

  • Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira de distribuidores estratégicos de foodservice e operadores de vending machine na Região Sudeste do Brasil.
  • Liderar e desenvolver diretamente um profissional da equipe comercial, estabelecendo metas, acompanhando performance e promovendo seu crescimento profissional.
  • Construir e executar Joint Business Plans (JBP), definindo estratégias, metas e planos de crescimento com os distribuidores.
  • Monitorar e impulsionar indicadores-chave de desempenho do canal, incluindo:
  • Sell-out
  • Cobertura geográfica
  • Positivação de clientes
  • Ticket médio
  • Margem e rentabilidade
  • Mix e desenvolvimento de categorias
  • Desenvolver iniciativas comerciais e programas de incentivo para acelerar resultados e aumentar a produtividade dos distribuidores.
  • Realizar visitas constantes a campo, acompanhando rotas e apoiando diretamente as equipes comerciais dos distribuidores.
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão da carteira de clientes e crescimento da participação de mercado no Sudeste.
  • Prospectar novos distribuidores e desenvolver novos negócios para as marcas de Foodservice da Kerry.
  • Treinar e capacitar equipes de vendas dos distribuidores sobre produtos, portfólio e oportunidades de mercado.
  • Trabalhar de forma consultiva com clientes e distribuidores para desenvolver soluções alinhadas às necessidades dos segmentos de foodservice.
  • Gerenciar e expandir projetos junto a operadores estratégicos de vending machine, garantindo crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e aumento da participação de mercado.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com contas-chave do segmento de vending machine e identificar oportunidades de inovação e expansão do canal.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Supply Chain, Customer Care, Marketing e demais áreas internas para assegurar excelência na execução comercial e assertividade de forecast.
  • Participar de eventos, Innovation Days e iniciativas estratégicas voltadas ao desenvolvimento do canal Foodservice.

Qualifications and skills

  • Mínimo de 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área comercial, preferencialmente nos segmentos de Foodservice, Ingredientes, Café, Panificação, Confeitaria ou canais indiretos.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Engenharia de Alimentos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência na gestão e desenvolvimento de distribuidores de foodservice.
  • Experiência comprovada no canal de vending machine é mandatória (must-have).
  • Histórico consistente de resultados em gestão de contas estratégicas e desenvolvimento de negócios no segmento de vending machine.
  • Experiência prévia em liderança de pessoas, desenvolvimento de equipes e gestão de performance.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção e execução de Joint Business Plans (JBP).
  • Vivência na gestão de indicadores comerciais e desenvolvimento de estratégias de crescimento.
  • Forte atuação em campo e experiência acompanhando equipes comerciais e distribuidores.
  • Conhecimento avançado de gestão de canais indiretos e distribuidores.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver estratégias de sell-out e expansão de mercado.
  • Conhecimento de indicadores de distribuição e performance comercial.
  • Experiência na criação e implementação de programas de incentivo e ativação comercial.
  • Capacidade analítica para acompanhamento de KPIs e identificação de oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Habilidade para conduzir negociações comerciais complexas e projetos estratégicos.
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, influência e desenvolvimento de times.
  • Perfil altamente energético e orientado para resultados.
  • Forte senso de dono e espírito empreendedor.
  • Visão estratégica combinada com excelência na execução.
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente e focado em crescimento.
  • Facilidade para construir relacionamentos e influenciar parceiros comerciais.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes e forte presença em campo.
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em diferentes segmentos dentro do canal foodservice.

About Kerry

A Kerry é a empresa líder mundial em soluções de sabor e nutrição para as indústrias de alimentos, bebidas e farmacêutica. Todos os dias, trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para criar produtos mais saudáveis, saborosos e sustentáveis, consumidos por bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Nossa visão é ser o parceiro mais valorizado de nossos clientes, contribuindo para um mundo de nutrição sustentável. Construir uma carreira na Kerry significa ter a oportunidade de ajudar a moldar o futuro da alimentação, ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve seu potencial em um ambiente verdadeiramente global e diverso.

title: Partner Management Manager (Commercial Focus)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Partner Management Manager to lead strategic partnerships and drive sustainable business growth. This role requires a strong commercial mindset, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and proven experience navigating complex and long sales cycles with senior decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing high-impact partnerships while owning the full partnership lifecycle—from opportunity identification and deal structuring through implementation, growth, and long-term relationship management.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close collaboration with Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and senior leadership teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership Development

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnership opportunities aligned with company growth objectives.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key external stakeholders, including C-level executives and senior decision-makers.
  • Develop partnership strategies that create long-term commercial value and competitive advantage.
  • Conduct market analysis to identify emerging trends, white spaces, and new business opportunities.

Commercial Negotiation & Deal Management

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and sophisticated deal structures.
  • Own the end-to-end partnership process, from prospecting and opportunity qualification to contract execution and post-launch growth.
  • Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, pricing models, revenue-sharing frameworks, and strategic collaboration terms.
  • Manage contract renewals, renegotiations, and expansion opportunities to maximize partner lifetime value.
  • Drive alignment among internal and external stakeholders throughout the negotiation process.

Partner Growth & Account Management

  • Develop strategic account plans for key partners to drive revenue growth and deepen relationships.
  • Monitor partnership performance through KPIs, business reviews, and growth initiatives.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing partnerships.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to ensure alignment, performance, and long-term success.

Qualifications

description:

title: Quality Manager
description:
About ROHA

From one small office in India in 1972 to a leading Multinational Company, engaged in Manufacture and Marketing of colors and food ingredients, ROHA today has offices in 22 countries, 14 technical application labs in many time zones globally. Manufacturing facilities are spread out across 14 countries: US, UK, Spain, Italy, India, South Africa, Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, China, Egypt, Brazil, Mexico & Australia. ROHA's products are marketed in more than 130 countries. Its portfolio includes natural extracts (oleoresins, juices and concentrates), an exclusive range of synthetic colors for the cosmetics and household goods industries, industrial colors, and animal feed additives.

We are hiring Quality Manager

Looking candidates from FOOD INDUSTRY ONLY

Candidates must be based in or near Itaquaquecetuba

Opportunity for Mid Management Level

5 days Working

Reporting to Regional Quality Manager

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, including laboratory technicians.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality policies, procedures, and systems in accordance with GMP, HACCP, and food safety standards.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian and international regulatory requirements applicable to food color manufacturing.
  • Oversee testing of raw materials, in-process materials, and finished products.
  • Review and approve product specifications, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and finished product releases.
  • Develop, review, and maintain laboratory Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and testing methodologies.
  • Monitor laboratory and production compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
  • Manage preventive maintenance and calibration programs for laboratory equipment.
  • Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Partner with Production to troubleshoot process and quality-related issues.
  • Lead internal, customer, certification, and third-party audits, ensuring timely responses to audit findings.
  • Manage customer quality questionnaires and provide technical support and product application guidance.
  • Support new product development and identify opportunities for R&D projects.
  • Coordinate product recall activities when required.
  • Ensure all QA/QC documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant.
  • Develop, mentor, and train quality personnel while promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Prepare quality metrics and reports for executive leadership.

Tudo sobre a função:

Por todo o mundo, e por muitas plantas e setores, nossas equipes multifuncionais estão trabalhando proativamente para otimizar o potencial de nosso sistema de manufatura. O que você vai fazer:

Se você tem boa capacidade de organização e análise, facilidade para se comunicar e colaborar, e consegue unir a sua visão estratégica com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa, essa é a sua chance! Ajude a Electrolux a continuar entregando experiências extraordinárias, e nós vamos te ajudar a voar muito mais alto.

Algumas responsabilidades serão:

- Treinar as pessoas da equipe, capacitando elas para suas funções conforme as metodologias e procedimentos internos da empresa;

Como parte da cultura de melhoria contínua, você participará de projetos e atividades de Lean Thinking (EMS / EAI).

Quem é você:

Você tem:

- Superior Completo e/ou Pós-Graduação, preferencialmente em Engenharia ou áreas Tecnológicas voltadas à indústria ou afins;

- Experiência em liderança e gestão de equipes (mínimo de 30 pessoas);

- Experiência com rotinas e processos de linha de produção e/ou montagem de produtos;

- Experiência em projetos de melhoria contínua com base na aplicação das técnicas e princípios do Lean Manufacturing;

- Conhecimento nas ferramentas da indústria 4.0;

- Desejável experiência e conhecimento em legislações aplicáveis em gestão de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente em empresas de grande porte;

- Pacote Office intermediário;

- Desejável Inglês intermediário.

Onde você vai estar:

Você terá como base a planta de São Carlos, localizada no bairro Vila Prado. Centro das operações de produção na linha de Food Preparation e Fabric Care, é o lugar de trabalho de equipes completamente focadas na entrega de melhores experiências para os consumidores.

Com o compromisso de criar uma cultura inclusiva e de cuidado com o bem-estar de todos, oferecemos os seguintes benefícios:

title: Keeta Senior Finance Operations Specialist
description:
Educational requirements: Bachelor's degree

Experience requirements: 10 years

Job responsibilities:

1. Business Support: Partner with Keeta Brazil business teams to assess the financial impact of business activities in accordance with local accounting standards (BR GAAP / IFRS) and compliance requirements. Design and deliver financial solutions to support business growth and commercial decision-making. 2. Local Accounting: Develop a deep understanding of Brazil's financial compliance framework. Ensure accurate and compliant bookkeeping of local financial transactions. 3. Finance Digitalization: Collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive finance informatization initiatives, including online billing and settlement, automated accounting entries, business-finance data reconciliation, and financial system upgrades. 4. Process Optimization: Lead process reviews to improve finance operations efficiency and accuracy. Identify workflow bottlenecks and redundancies. Actively explore and apply AI tools (LLM-assisted solution writing, automated reconciliation, anomaly detection, etc.) to enhance finance operational effectiveness. 5. Cross-functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with other finance teams to support business needs and other assigned tasks.

Job requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or above in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related fields; 8+ years of relevant finance/accounting experience; prior experience in accounting operations and financial system integration is preferred. 2. Background in a public accounting firm (Big 4 or reputable local firm, at least 4+ years) and/or finance roles at an internet/technology company (in-house). Candidates with both backgrounds are strongly preferred. 3. Familiarity with Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP / IFRS), local bookkeeping practices, Financial Software (e.g., Totvs, SAP) and Brazil's tax invoice system (NF-e, NFS-e, etc.) is a strong plus. 4. Strong communication and coordination skills; ability to work effectively with business stakeholders. Excellent analytical and logical thinking; detail-oriented, responsible, and a strong team player with a service mindset. 5. Able to use both English and Portuguese as daily working languages.6. Passionate about AI — enthusiastic and curious about how AI can reshape finance workflows.

Job highlights:

- Be part of Keeta's overseas business journey from day one — deeply involved in daily operations and finance system building (including AI initiatives), with full exposure to international finance at scale. - A rare and highly rewarding experience in global internet finance, with broad personal development opportunities.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.

  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).

Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação: Juazeiro/BA

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Commercial Financial BP
description:
At Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies , our 8,000+ global associates are proud to come to work each day, knowing that what we do impacts the lives of patients around the world.

We make medical devices and related products that are used to collect, separate, manufacture and process various components of blood and cells. With our innovative technologies and service offerings, we touch a patient’s life every second of every day and are committed to continuing to increase the number of patients we serve.

With some of the best and brightest minds in the industry, an unmatched global footprint, comprehensive benefits and a distinct culture, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is a great place to work, grow and be part of a team that is focused on making a difference. Consider joining our team and unlock your potential.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Commercial Finance Business Partner LATAM to support the commercial organization across the region and act as a key financial partner in business growth and decision-making.

This is a regional role with exposure to multiple LATAM markets, working closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Operations and other business stakeholders. The position will play a critical role in connecting financial strategy with commercial objectives, providing insights that support profitable and sustainable growth.

The ideal candidate will combine strong financial expertise with a genuine business mindset, the ability to challenge commercial decisions constructively, and the agility to operate in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Partner with LATAM commercial leadership to analyze business performance and identify opportunities to improve sales, profitability and operating results.

• Prepare and evaluate business cases for customer transactions, new business opportunities and strategic initiatives, providing financial recommendations to support decision-making.

• Analyze sales, margins, profitability, pricing and operating expenses, identifying risks and opportunities and recommending proactive actions.

• Lead and coordinate budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning processes across LATAM, including variance analysis and management reporting.

• Develop financial models and projections for new business opportunities, customer solutions, investments and strategic projects.

• Support the commercial organization in evaluating customer deals, pricing strategies and profitability, challenging assumptions when necessary to ensure sustainable growth.

• Prepare weekly sales forecasts and monthly reports and dashboards to provide clear visibility into LATAM commercial performance.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance teams across different LATAM countries, acting as a bridge between regional and global finance organizations.

• Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, pricing competitiveness and financial efficiency across the region.

• Support Sales and commercial teams with financial tools, analysis and training to strengthen business decision-making.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Education

• University degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration or a related field. Accounting background is a plus.

Experience

• 7+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally with 5–8 years in Commercial Finance, FP&A or Business Partnering roles.

• Experience working with commercial teams in a regional or multinational environment.

• Strong understanding of pricing, profitability, forecasting and financial modeling.

• Experience working across LATAM or other emerging markets is highly valued.

Technical Skills

• Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities.

• Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and P&L analysis.

• Experience with pricing and profitability analysis.

• Ability to translate financial and market data into actionable business recommendations.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with ERP and financial systems, preferably SAP.

Business & Leadership Skills

• Strong commercial mindset and understanding of business growth drivers.

• Ability to influence decisions and challenge commercial strategies through data and financial insights.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders across different countries and cultures.

Languages

• Advanced English is required.

• Spanish and/or Portuguese are highly valued for regional collaboration.

Location & Travel

The position will be based in one of Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies' LATAM locations, with a regional scope covering key markets across Latin America. Availability to travel within the region as required.

WHY JOIN TERUMO BLOOD AND CELL TECHNOLOGIES?

Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is part of Terumo Group, founded in 1921 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

In 2024, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies reached $1.5 billion in revenue.

We employ nearly 8,000 associates globally, with global headquarters in Lakewood, CO, U.S., and regional headquarters in Brussels, Buenos Aires, Singapore and Tokyo.

We manufacture devices, disposable sets and solutions at our facilities in Belgium, India, Japan, Northern Ireland, the U.S. and Vietnam. Our global presence enables us to serve customers in more than 130 countries.

Our core values help set our direction, guide our actions and keep us true to our corporate mission of contributing to society through healthcare.

  • Respect – Appreciative of others
  • Integrity – Guided by our mission
  • Care – Empathetic to patients
  • Quality – Committed to excellence
  • Creativity – Striving for innovation

title: Head of Project Control
description:
About us

Hanseatic Global Terminals (HGT) is a fully owned subsidiary of Hapag-Lloyd. Operating from Rotterdam, HGT manages a portfolio of stakes in 26 marine terminals and complementary logistics services across 13 countries across 5 continents: Europe, North America, South America, Asia, Africa - with plans to expand its stakes to ~30 terminals by 2030.

Spanning key regions, its portfolio comprises port terminals and related logistics services operated by Hanseatic Global Terminals Latin America in Latin America and Florida (USA), and, in the booming Indian market, it is present through the container terminals, depots and rail business of J M Baxi, India’s largest integrated terminal and logistics provider. Additionally, HGT’s presence in strategic European hubs, such as Germany, France and the Mediterranean, enhances its global network and allows it to offer seamless, efficient logistics and supply chain solutions to customers worldwide.

At HGT, we are a highly motivated team of experienced international professionals who believe that growth in any partnership comes from trust and dedication. Our commitment to provide highly efficient terminal operations that are safe, sustainable, and reliable is rooted in a simple yet powerful vision: “offering exceptional service quality at all times.”

The project: Hanseatic Global Terminals Aracruz port terminal:

Hanseatic Global Terminals (HGT) is embarking on an exciting new chapter with the development of Hanseatic Global Terminals Aracruz , a state‑of‑the‑art container terminal created in partnership with the Imetame Group. Following HGT’s recent agreement to acquire 50% of the shares in Imetame Logística Porto (ILP) , this joint venture marks a significant strategic investment in Brazil’s evolving port landscape and will play a key role in strengthening global supply chain connectivity.

Located in Aracruz, Espírito Santo, the new terminal is designed to be a modern transshipment and gateway hub for the region. Expected to launch operations by mid‑2028, the facility will feature a capacity of approximately 1.2 million TEU, 750 meters of quay, advanced cargo‑handling technology, and 17 meters of water depth, enabling the efficient handling of the industry’s largest vessels.

As HGT and the Imetame Group work together to build and operate this future‑ready terminal, we are assembling a team of talented professionals who will help shape the next major milestone in Brazil’s port infrastructure development. The project represents an opportunity to be part of a transformational venture that will set new standards for performance, innovation, and operational excellence.

The position

The Head of Project Control is responsible for creating a clear and trusted view of project performance by ensuring accurate, timely, and transparent communication across internal teams and external stakeholders. This role brings project management excellence to the forefront by applying best practices, and tools, to support strong decision making and maintain focus on customer value as it evolves. At the same time, the Head of Project Controls cultivates a proactive, insight-driven project environment by using leading and lagging indicators to anticipate risks early, highlight improvement opportunities, and guide the project consistently toward successful outcomes.

Success requires transparency, deep expertise, and a forward-looking mindset that continuously predicts, improves, and strengthens project performance.

Key Responsibilities

The Head of Project Controls is expected to perform the following responsibilities throughout the project:

General

  • Implement, maintain, and champion the transparent use of HGT project management and control tools across the project team, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
  • Establish and maintain the project’s scope, schedule, quality, and budget baselines.
  • Facilitate:

-Effective application of core project governance processes, including (Change management, scope, schedule, requirements, and budget changes)

-Risk management, ensuring timely input and ownership from the project team

-Document Management and correspondence registration system

  • Monitor progress against approved baselines and ensure that deviations are identified early, addressed promptly, and escalated or reported when necessary
  • Ensure correct and timely project performance reporting:

-within the project and team.

-to Project Director and other relevant project leaders.

-to Head Office.

-to other corporate counterparts (as required).

Communication

  • Function as primary point of contact for all project control systems and be responsible for the user rights administration.
  • Liaise with the functional counterpart on project control system issues and improvements.
  • Hold regular touchpoints with construction, equipment, IT and finance teams to stay ahead of potential project control issues.
  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with head office counterparts, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.

Interfaces

  • Work closely with all project disciplines to ensure consistent, accurate, and coordinated project controls.
  • Liaise with relevant HGT global departments to maintain alignment with company standards and best practices.

Job requirements

  • Relevant professional experience: 10 years overall, including a minimum of 5 years within a project controls functional discipline.

title: Executivo de Vendas RJ (Offshore)
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Responsável por promover e vender as soluções de instrumentação da Emerson para Fabricantes de Equipamentos Originais (OEMs) na região do Rio de Janeiro. Essa função tem como foco construir parcerias sólidas, identificar oportunidades de crescimento e oferecer suporte técnico e comercial para garantir o sucesso do cliente.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes OEM para impulsionar as vendas de instrumentação da Emerson;
  • Identificar novas oportunidades de negócio e executar estratégias para aumentar a participação de mercado;
  • Fornecer expertise técnica e suporte consultivo durante todo o ciclo de vendas;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas para garantir a execução eficaz e dentro do prazo dos projetos;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas e contribuir para os objetivos de crescimento regional.

Quem você é:

Você mantém uma atitude positiva e uma abordagem voltada para o futuro, apesar de circunstâncias preocupantes ou contratempos. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você conquista a confiança e o respeito das pessoas com facilidade. Você vê os erros como oportunidades para aprender.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Graduação em Engenharia (preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica, Automação, Instrumentação ou Mecânica);
  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência em vendas técnicas ou suporte técnico de instrumentação e controle
  • Experiência prática com processos industriais (óleo e gás, química), alimentos, papel e celulose, mineração e metalurgia);
  • Português fluente e Inglês intermediário a avançado (para leitura de manuais, treinamentos e comunicação com matriz);
  • CRM (Salesforce ou similar);
  • Pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

Conhecimento em softwares de configuração de instrumentos:

  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas (IEC, ISA);

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.
